name: Gia Russa Potato Gnocchi (Pillowy Soft, Boiled)
whyItWorks: Tender dumplings made from mashed potatoes and wheat flour. Soft, pillowy texture digests easily when boiled until they float and tossed in gentle olive oil.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drop into boiling salted water. As soon as they float to the top (2–3 minutes), simmer for 1 more minute to ensure complete softness, then gently scoop out.
